Subject: Deputy on-call delegation proposal for Electra weekend launch

Hi team,

Electra's engineering team is going live with their feature rollout this weekend (Sat 23rd 00:00–06:00 PT). They’ve asked for a temporary adjustment to our P1/P2 on-call coverage while they ramp traffic. Specifically they want a dedicated deputy for P1 during the first 6 hours of their launch window to ensure sub-15m acknowledgement and a direct escalation path to a senior infra engineer if the deputy needs assistance.

Attached is a short proposal: "proposed-deputy-matrix.xlsx" (roles, shifts, phone escalation order). Key asks:
- Redwood assigns a deputy (named on-call) for 00:00–06:00 PT on Sat 23 May for Electra-only P1s.
- Maintain standard P2 routing; no change unless Electra requests.
- Escalation tree: deputy -> Monica (ops lead) -> Marissa (support director) -> Diego (EM on-call exec) -> Electra exec bridge if unresolved after 90m.

Operational constraints / notes:
- This is time-limited for the initial 6-hour ramp window only.
- We propose compensating with a one-time service credit if deputy is paged more than 3x in the window (we should align with Sales on credits).
- We will publish a short runbook link for the deputy: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-deputy-oncall-java-runbook

Requesting:
1) Internal sign-off from Marissa and Monica for delegation + escalation contacts.
2) Sales confirmation from Karthik on credit language and communication to Electra.
3) Electra confirm acceptance of the temporary carveout and escalation flow.

Sophia — tagging you to confirm this addresses Electra’s needs and to capture any additional contact info (phone/SMS).

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Senior Support Ops, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: proposed-deputy-matrix.xlsx (xlsx), electra-escalation-contacts.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deputy on-call delegation proposal for Electra weekend launch

Diego — thanks for the clear proposal and matrix. I support a short deputy carveout for the first 6-hour ramp with two conditions:

1) The deputy must be a senior SRE or support engineer with explicit write access to the Electra routing rules (so handoffs are immediate).
2) We need a documented fallback: if the deputy is unavailable within 10 minutes, Monica becomes primary and we escalate immediately to Marissa.

On credits: we should avoid blanket credits. Karthik, suggest we offer a conditional credit (e.g., credit equal to 2 days usage if >3 P1s within window) and make the trigger explicit in the mutual action plan.

Operational items before sign-off:
- Confirm deputy name (to avoid on-call overlap).
- Confirm phone escalation numbers (Sophia, please confirm).
- Share the short runbook with Electra and confirm they’ve tested alarm noise for false positives.

Once those are confirmed I'm happy to sign off.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Support
Redwood Inference
